definition: Confirmation is a Christian rite historically understood as strengthening faith. In Roman Catholic practice it is the second sacrament and centers on the bishop’s anointing with chrism, while in Reformed churches that keep it, it is mainly a catechetical renewal of baptismal vows, often before first communion.
